vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE Services record CVE-2026-76213 is state=PUBLISHED (https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-76213) and describes CWE-307: the 2FA failure counter is session-scoped and reset on successful password re-authentication, so an attacker who already knows the password can obtain a fresh session or re-authenticate to keep guessing TOTP codes. Vendor advisory GHSA-f98m-hcjv-7rp9 (https://github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ/security/advisories/GHSA-f98m-hcjv-7rp9) is published, not withdrawn, and traces POST authenticate setting 2fa_pending_user_id plus 2fa_failed_attempts=0, then POST check incrementing only that session counter and dropping pending state at five. At advisory tree 5d4a975cdc53dca26383f2b8a56596b1272fcac2 those exact assignments exist in both phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Frontend/AuthenticationController.php (lines 207-208, 286, 305) and phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Administration/AuthenticationController.php (lines 81-82, 239, 263). GitHub advisory GHSA-xgjh-9vcx-v63q withdrawn_at is null; GitHub withdrawn_at is not authoritative in any case.

That non-merge commit's production diff on phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Administration/AuthenticationController.php is the first public write of the vulnerable state machine: session set of 2fa_pending_user_id, unconditional 2fa_failed_attempts=0 after password success, five-guess session cap, per-failure increment. git blame on tag 4.1.6 attributes those admin lines to 2acabf760cd7e44ec589a3e207381e9a480dd64f. 388bcf3cb1ee356c0b7b54d127ad9b5e448ae19f is a later parallel first-write of the same admin patch on main (same author date, commit 2026-05-02T11:31:57+02:00, not an ancestor of 4.1.x). 410208b90f1d01534812ac5203d3e8d9c7bd591f (2026-06-19, phpmyfaq/index.php) and 6a69f6e2142fde722165c65b7e0a49f3176e87be (same day, Frontend AuthenticationController; message 'Mirror the admin flow') copy the already-written mechanism onto frontend surfaces and are not the BIC. The primary's index.php-only pickaxe therefore named a later copy.

findings: CVE-2026-76213 is a real CWE-307: 2FA lockout lives only in the session and is reset to zero on every successful password authentication, so a password-holding attacker can rotate cookies or re-authenticate to guess TOTP without bound. CVE.org state is PUBLISHED; vendor GHSA-f98m-hcjv-7rp9 is published.

Primary introducer_sha 410208b90f1d01534812ac5203d3e8d9c7bd591f is not the BIC. That commit is the 2026-06-19 frontend copy into phpmyfaq/index.php. The first public write of the session-reset throttle is 2acabf760cd7e44ec589a3e207381e9a480dd64f on 2026-04-24 in Administration AuthenticationController.php; git blame on 4.1.6 attributes the admin reset lines to that commit. 6a69f6e2142fde722165c65b7e0a49f3176e87be later mirrors the same admin flow into Frontend AuthenticationController.php on main.

Immediate parent 4e31e12a9c54afbfee03bc67c5300624c61013e7 lacks both session keys; admin check() there still accepts an arbitrary user-id (predecessor GHSA-9pq7-mfwh-xx2j / CVE-2026-45010, patched in 4.1.2 by this same BIC plus pending-user binding).

Affected exact objects: session-reset mechanism is absent from 4.1.1 and present in 4.1.2 through 4.1.6. Primary claim that only 4.1.6 has these lines is true of the frontend index.php copy, not of the admin first-write. Direct fix 59593a013862094724e68b3ace5c9dd0a2b516cb is in 4.1.7 (28d6f641c16e3015d51d0a01d14841b845251f35) and not in 4.1.6.
BIC-object authorship is named human Thorsten Rinne with no AI/bot/generator/co-author marker, so the NOT_AI class still holds. Do not project the advisory's later AI-drafting sentence onto the BIC.

corrected_fields.bug_semantics: A correct password reaches the 2FA pending state and sets 2fa_failed_attempts to 0 in the current session. Wrong TOTP submissions increment only that session value and clear the pending state at the five-guess cap. An attacker who knows the password can re-authenticate, or use a fresh cookie jar, to recreate the pending state with a zero counter; correct-password requests do not consume the failed-password budget. The state machine was first written on admin POST /authenticate and POST /check, then copied to the 4.1 frontend phpmyfaq/index.php and the main Frontend AuthenticationController.
corrected_fields.flaw_origin: Commit 2acabf760cd7e44ec589a3e207381e9a480dd64f is the smallest public first-writer of the advisory mechanism: its Administration AuthenticationController.php diff introduced the session-only five-attempt counter, increment and cap, and the unconditional counter reset after each successful password authentication. Immediate parent 4e31e12a9c54afbfee03bc67c5300624c61013e7 has neither 2FA session key. 410208b90f1d01534812ac5203d3e8d9c7bd591f and 6a69f6e2142fde722165c65b7e0a49f3176e87be are later frontend copies of that already-written pattern, not the BIC.
